data.one_liner: Launch URLs, files and app schemes on Windows from Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Windows implementation of the url_launcher plugin. It opens web links, mailto links, and file URLs using the default system handlers. It integrates with the federated url_launcher API so you can call launchUrl without platform checks.
use_when: You need to open external links or files on Windows desktops
You are building a Flutter app that runs on multiple platforms and want Windows support for url_launcher
avoid_when: You need advanced browser control beyond just launching a URL
strengths: Seamless integration with the federated url_launcher API
Automatically included when using url_launcher on Windows
Handles file URLs with UTF‑8 paths and provides proper error logging
weaknesses: Only works on Windows; other platforms need their own implementations
Relies on system default handlers, so behavior can vary across Windows versions

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: A single package that pulls in the appropriate platform implementations automatically, including Windows.

alternatives.name: url_launcher_android
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need Android support, this platform‑specific package is smaller.
